scientific_integrity: Proof is infinite and symbolic, with standalone finite modular cross-check; no independent audit claimed.
scientific_limitations: Every odd integer parameter, positive indices and two-adic closure only; not even parameters. The classical parameter P=1 has prior complete residue-frequency data (Bundschuh and Bundschuh 2010) and is not separately novel. Unindexed companion-frequency generalizations remain a bibliographic priority risk.
title: Exact two-adic quotient-set closure for every odd-parameter Lucas companion
